title: RevocationVoteView
description: Read-optimized projection of an imagodei RevocationVote DHT entry. Source of truth: DHT. Rebuildable via signal replay on RecoveryV2Signal::RevocationVoteSubmitted.

dhtAnchorHash.description: Holochain ActionHash of the RevocationVote entry (base64).

revocationDhtAnchorHash.description: dhtAnchorHash of the parent KeyRevocation entry.

revocationId.description: Coordinator-generated ID of the parent KeyRevocation.

approved.description: True if the steward approves the revocation.

attestation.description: Non-empty human-readable justification for the vote.
